description: LABELLED SYNTHETIC, source-grounded (CommandExecutionItem carries the command string the exec processor reports): one command_execution item whose command runs grep, a pipe and a Python interpreter. The source reports one operation with that command string and its aggregated output; Journal records exactly that operation with the command line verbatim, never parsed into argv, and invents no tool call, child operation or operating-system action for grep, python3 or the pipeline. Classifying commands inside shell text is a consumer's analysis, not an execution fact the stream reported.

absent_events.why: no model request for grep, python3 or the pipeline was reported
no started tool invocation for a command inside the shell text was reported
no tool result for a command inside the shell text was reported

/tool_operation/argv: grep -rn TODO src | python3 -c "import sys; print(len(sys.stdin.readlines()))"

counterexamples.why: The source reports a command string; splitting it is shell parsing the stream did not do.
The pipeline is one reported operation; recording only its first command invents a different operation.
grep inside the shell text is not a tool the model requested or the stream reported.
